raw:
Lewis Hamilton won **82** Grands Prix driving for Mercedes between 2000 and 2025. Those wins came from 2013 to 2021, using the season standings for each year:

| Season | Hamilton wins (Mercedes) |
|---|---|
| 2013 | 1 |
| 2014 | 11 |
| 2015 | 10 |
| 2016 | 10 |
| 2017 | 9 |
| 2018 | 11 |
| 2019 | 11 |
| 2020 | 11 |
| 2021 | 8 |
| 2022–2024 | 0 |

He won nothing in 2022–2024 with Mercedes and moved to Ferrari for 2025, so those seasons add nothing.

ANSWER: 82
